links.comparator_used: Not stated in the abstract; the study evaluates model responses when authoritative WET guideline passages are provided, with no explicit no-retrieval arm described
links.outcome: Accuracy, consistency and fidelity of reasoning on clinician-vetted WET guideline questions
links.effect: No numbers reported in the abstract; errors persist even when authoritative passages are provided, while RAG can constrain outputs
links.tradeoff: Retrieving the right evidence does not guarantee correct reasoning, so safe deployment requires assessing reasoning as rigorously as retrieval
links.quote: In evaluating model responses to curated clinician-vetted questions, we find that errors persist even when authoritative passages are provided.
